hypothesis: Applying numactl interleave-all immediately before exec of simpleFoam inside each MPI rank may change native solver timing compared with each rank's default policy, after the rank-level policy mechanism has been independently qualified.

mechanism_evidence.observation: All 56 interleaved candidate ranks reported interleave policy across both NUMA nodes with an exact 8 MiB mapping. Control ranks reported default policy and single-node 2048-page mappings. Rank CPU affinities matched between policies.
mechanism_evidence.limit: This qualifies rank policy behavior and the diagnostic's page mapping, not solver performance or a speed improvement.

control: Same accepted Scotch source, runtime, solver launch, physics, 40-step horizon, sampler, and inherited preparation validation in all arms.
treatment: Default MPI-rank memory policy versus numactl --interleave=all immediately before the rank wrapper execs simpleFoam.
